Iconic EQ Sniper Rifle (w/ Foregrip, Infrared Nightvision Scope, Sniper Rifle Rechamber, & Tech Rebuild). Holds 3 rounds. Can see simple target outlines through one layer of Thin or Thick Cover. While charged, this weapon can fire through up to one layer of Thin or Thick Cover and ablates 1 additional SP. It also ablates 1 additional SP while uncharged whenever it would ablate armor (+1 SP Ablation Non-Charged, +2 SP Ablation Charged).

Variant of: Nekomata
Category: Super Luxury
Fabrication: DV29 - 10,000eb - 1 Month
Class: EQ Sniper Rifle
Range: Sniper Rifle
Pre-installed: Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Super Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
